use_when: the user explicitly enabled Alatyr Debug Mode for the current task or session
the user requests status finalization disablement or comparison of an existing debug record

conditional_context.when: activation checkpoint finalization disablement repair or comparison is requested
creating or repairing a debug record
linking or validating non-empty durable engineering-evidence IDs

expand_when: event attribution has an unresolved causal conflict
a direction-changing correction lacks a rejected hypothesis or replacement invariant chain
architectural supervision classification conflicts with structured impacts
a durable engineering-evidence ID does not resolve exactly once
repository binding or external projection cannot support the claim
privacy or retention policy conflicts with requested capture
cross-task comparison needs selected records because index evidence is insufficient
budget_behavior: load the compact index and at most the active or explicitly selected records; checkpoint material events only and never load raw session history
final_evidence: record ID path and capture quality
compact event-derived metrics with structured architectural and direction-replacement evidence
final result binding and external projection
privacy publication validation and residual uncertainty
